description.en: Registers a technique-cutscene participant (see CMND_INIT_SKILL_SCRIPT) from an existing team's roster, identified by its position index within the team rather than by a parameter ID (see CMND_SETUP_SKL_SQ_CHARAM).
Team side the character belongs to.
Team data the character is drawn from.
Position index within the team roster.

Likely true once the roster character participant was registered; null if the call was invalid (fewer than 3 arguments). The success value is produced by an internal setup helper (sub_236258) that wasn't fully traceable from the decompiled code.

example.code:
// Register a technique-cutscene participant by roster position index
CMND_SETUP_SKL_SQ_CHARAM_BY_IDX(_side, _index, _team, _pos_idx);
